name: ACE Web — Team Chat Harness
narrative: ace-web gives the ACE team a persistent, multi-player chat interface on top of Claude with streaming responses, session library, and share links.

jj.name: Jonathan Jackson
jj.intro: Jonathan leads the ACE initiative and uses ace-web daily for Claude conversations about CRISPR-Connect opportunities.

slides.title: Library — session overview
slides.narration: Clean session management with search, filter by status, and one-click archive — not just a chat box, a real workspace.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — realistic project sessions visible. B: App Page 5/5 — shadcn-styled header with search/filter/upload/new chat. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5. E: Demo Ready 5/5.

slides.title: Chat — clean entry into a fresh session
slides.narration: Click + New Chat in the sidebar to create a session. The sidebar gives instant context across all your conversations, and the CLI auth banner gates the send box if Claude isn't connected yet.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — populated sidebar, clear empty-chat state. B: App Page 5/5 — shadcn-migrated SendBox, proper focus ring, disabled send button styled correctly. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5 — narration covers both the entry flow and the CLI gating. E: Demo Ready 5/5.

slides.title: Chat — typed message with CLI gating
slides.narration: Type a message and the textarea shows the proper focus ring. The send button stays disabled until the Claude CLI is connected — no zombie streaming, no silent failures.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — typed message visible, send disabled, presence chip in header. B: App Page 5/5 — shadcn Button variants, semantic tokens, proper dark mode support. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5 — demonstrates the gating fix. E: Demo Ready 5/5.

slides.title: Share — read-only link
slides.narration: One-click share links with clipboard copy fallback. Anonymous read-only access without exposing participant identities.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — share link created, manual copy fallback when clipboard is denied. B: App Page 5/5 — shadcn popover styling, primary button, destructive icon button for revoke. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5. E: Demo Ready 5/5 — fixed the contradictory feedback issue caught during this walkthrough.

slides.title: Settings — personal API tokens
slides.narration: Self-service token management for the ace-upload CLI. Create, view creation date, and revoke — no admin needed.

ai_evaluation.commentary: Overall: 5/5 (weakest: none). A: Content 5/5 — demo-laptop token visible. B: App Page 5/5 — clean settings. C: Screenshot 5/5. D: Slide 5/5 — token management clearly demonstrated. E: Demo Ready 5/5.
